name: Slice Saber
summary:
A stream of furniture is flying past you, and you have a lightsaber.

Stand on a platform high above the world - a wooden deck in a bright sky, a rooftop in a neon city, a crater over a lava lake, a glass dome on the seabed - while couches, desks, arcade cabinets, pinball machines and bookshelves sweep past. Cut them in half. Every cut is real: the blade slices the actual geometry wherever you swing, and the halves tumble away showing foam, timber and circuit board.

Chain slices to build your combo. Multip
